posts.title: Beyond the Context Window - The Architecture of a Trustworthy AI Co-Designer
posts.description: The industry talks about long-context AI as a capacity problem: bigger windows, stuff everything in, let the model sort it out. Building Nova, a persistent AI co-designer that works alongside board game designers across months of sessions, taught us the opposite. posts.title: Baudrillardian Digital Twin - Engineering Against Hyperreality
posts.description: A digital twin starts out as a faithful mirror of a factory floor. Over time, the relationship inverts. The factory begins to be reshaped so that the twin can render it cleanly.
